figure.title: Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (b) Λ = 35°; t/c = 0.04.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, common to the three plots of the page and labelled only under the bottom (angle-of-attack) plot: -.2 at the left frame line, 0 at the heavy axis line, .8 at the right frame line, labels every 0.1. On the graph paper the heavy vertical lines fall every 0.05 C_L (about 71.5 px on this page), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.025), fine lines every 0.005 (about 7.2 px). The C_L = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D, scale on the right of the middle plot: labels 0, .04, .08, .12, .16, .20. The heavy horizontal lines fall every 0.02 C_D (about 71.5 px; the labels sit on every second one), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.01), fine lines every 0.002 (about 7.2 px). The C_D = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.content_note: Middle plot of the page only (C_D against C_L). One faired curve with 8 hollow circles without a centre dot (radius about 13 px), all single: no doubled outline or second circle seen. Circle 2 sits on the crossing of the heavy C_L = 0 axis line (through the circle, close to its centre) and the heavy 0.02 C_D line, with the faired curve along that line through it; circle 3 has the heavy 0.02 C_D line across its lower half; circles 4, 5 and 6 each have a vertical grid line through them (0.225, 0.35 and 0.45 C_L), circle 6 also the 0.08 C_D line across its lower part; circle 7 has its left edge about 1 px from the heavy 0.55 C_L line and its top edge about 5 px below the 0.12 C_D line; circle 8 has the heavy 0.16 C_D line across its upper part. This page is drawn at a slightly larger scale on the scan than page 18 (about 35.6 px per 0.025 C_L against 34.6) and is rotated the other way: horizontal lines about 12 px higher at the right frame than at the left, vertical lines further left at the top. The scan shows 1-px steps in the grid lines along vertical seams (e.g. near x 590 and 740).

calibration.x_definition: C_L: vertical heavy and medium grid lines of the graph paper, every 0.025 from the left frame line (-0.20) to the right frame line (0.80).
calibration.y_definition: C_D: horizontal heavy and medium grid lines, every 0.01 from the heavy C_D = 0 line (labelled 0) to the 0.20 line (labelled .20).
